tool_input.command:
hops sql --no-verify --schema mlpabc21134_featurestore --json "
WITH d AS (
  SELECT r.request_id AS request_id, r.account_id AS account_id,
         ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6) AS distance_deg,
         p.base_score AS base_score
  FROM requests_1 r JOIN profiles_1 p ON r.account_id = p.account_id
)
SELECT request_id, account_id, distance_deg, ROUND(base_score - 0.1 * distance_deg, 6) AS score
FROM d ORDER BY request_id
" 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: Run join and transform via Trino
